snippet.title: People's Press Kiosk - GamePlay Trailer
snippet.description:
Run a kiosk in 1980s communist Poland. Check ration cards, distribute rationed goods, and dabble in illegal trade to support your family. Every decision can bring profit or trouble. #indiegame #simulator 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4843700/Peoples_Press_Kiosk/
